mentions.name: Mergi
mentions.description: This is a fast, native UI for reviewing GitHub pull requests that pre-loads everything to avoid GitHub's slowness. It includes a Review Queue for tracking pending PR reviews and AI-powered features.
mentions.problem: The demand for reviewing PRs has skyrocketed, and GitHub's slow interface makes reviewing painful.
mentions.audience: Developers who review GitHub pull requests
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Mergi. The demand for reviewing PRs sky-rocket in the past months, and I got really tired of Github slowness so I created my own "native" fast and painless UI where everything is pre-loaded.
